notes.title: Updated! To make gamers happier
notes.content:
- UI improvements. Showing Dungeon levels and missing Ionix crystal added!
- More instructions before starting your first quest
- Lighting in some zones improved
- Volume control added!
- Trivia bonus questions are disabled by default now
- Combat Log showed by default when you start. 

NEXT: we are studying on how we could improve controls and smooth camera without damaging existing functionality. That's not going to be easy...

- We are looking to redo the facade of the level dungeon village to conform to the original design of the game.

notes.title: Steam controller SETUP update
notes.content:
For those using Steam Controllers, the current most accurate config is now "Dev Controller". This update is to please a recent demand of our dear user: AKBAAR :-)

This will have a great impact on the appreciation of the game!!! The new config imitates the XBOX controller setup that was designed for this type of game.

We are still looking at making the mouse movement slower. Write us if you know how! We will write on this post if there is an update.

Hitting monsters do not need mouse pointing. If the mouse is not on a button but rather on the gameplay, the X attack will automatically hit the closest encounter.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30281093/be9d8e06e47301b598f6d9c2e60d8e779774f0a9.jpg[/img]

-Hidden buttons under the controller are to adjust first-person to third-person view.
-XYAB Hit/select, run, walk, dodge. Answer EBS questions. X+y,a,b special attack.

-Top left control pad: select/pick shortcut

-Top right control pad: Mouse
